stages.name: Settle what shapes everything
stages.why: Decisions that change what we build next. Cheap now, expensive later — a name change or an edition dropped after the disc exists costs weeks.

stages.name: Clean house
stages.why: Everything already built gets pushed, tested and released, so the rest builds on solid ground.

stages.name: nog and nogForge, finished
stages.why: The installer and the welcome app drive nog without a person; nog has to be done first.

stages.name: Our Sway, packaged
stages.why: The disc can't build Sway in a home folder. A package, held back until our patches fit each new Sway.

stages.name: The desktop, finished
stages.why: The base every style and app sits on: the bar never vanishes, one or two screens work, pop-ups follow the standard.

stages.name: The four styles and their colours
stages.why: Rice, Windows 11, KDE and Classic, each reviewed piece by piece; then the colour themes that make the cut; then themeForge 1.0.

stages.name: Passwords
stages.why: walletForge has to replace KDE's wallet before the disc ships without KDE; sudoForge gets its compact box and its GPG prompt.

stages.name: The Settings apps
stages.why: The Mint-sized set, in the order you set on 10-07: sound, network, Bluetooth first.

stages.name: First boot
stages.why: What someone sees the first time: the greeting, the prompt, the Welcome Center, the tier guide, the help pages, now that the desktop has settled.

stages.name: The disc's foundations
stages.why: The ISO recipe rebuilt for Sway: what goes on it, the known install bugs, the editions, the login screen, a live session that starts on any graphics card.

stages.name: installForge
stages.why: The installer, step by step in the order a person meets them, then the advanced parts.

stages.name: Testing
stages.why: A VM until zero problems, then the real thing: the NVMe in this PC, then a laptop.

stages.name: The release kit
stages.why: Everything a stranger needs before they download: the legal and privacy lines, the site, the guide, the ISO's home and signature.

stages.name: Launch
stages.why: Two years after the wish that started it.
